positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Software Development Engineer Intern
positions.description:
•	Designed 3 new key features for the SageMaker SDK so that its 5000+ users can better visualize, manage, and analyze their machine learning models & executions
•	Utilized Python to implement features that allow for visualization of machine learning models & access to previous models
•	Built new backend Java API that generates an adjacency list representing these models to support my new feature & to provide an improved approach for model visualization to SageMaker Studio UI
•	Evaluated 4 Python visualizations tools & identified the best based on customer demand & integration into Amazon systems

positions.title: Software Development Engineer Intern
positions.description:
•	Improved 2 backend API flows for SageMaker Pipelines
•	Implemented improved Pipeline deletion and stopping flows utilizing Java, AWS Lambda, and AWS Simple Queue Service
•	Played lead role in API design definition & actively corresponded with team members for enhancements

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern at Duke Office of Information Technology
positions.description:
•	Developed iOS mobile app with 6 interactive AR features for Duke Athletics Department to enhance the tour experience for the 10,000+ annual Duke Basketball Museum visitors
•	Utilized XCode (Swift, SceneKit, ARKit) to build a scavenger hunt with image recognition/3D tracking to overlay players’ highlight videos and to build other AR features (3D basketball shooting game, 360 degree view of museum, 3D player animations, Augmented Tour, & Duke Music)
•	Played lead role in product definition (AR features, UI/UX) & requirement analysis with clients
•	Implemented custom 3D models using Adobe (Dimension/Mixamo) & Apple (XCode, Reality Composer) to more accurately model Duke Basketball Players

positions.title: Project Lead
positions.description:
- Learned lab techniques(micro-pipetting, welding, etc)
- Led and organized our team's research to harness energy from the fusion (protons/neutrons) in an IEC-9000 reactor. We modeled and built an apparatus to directly absorb the thermal energy from the fusion reaction to a constantly flowing supply of oil in a heat exchanger chamber, which would heat water and build up steam to spin a turbine.

volunteerExperiences.description: I discharged patients and transported patients and laboratory specimens, accumulating over 250 hours and strengthening communication skills.

volunteerExperiences.role: Lakota Middle School Math Team Assistant Coach
volunteerExperiences.description:
- Trained over 30 middle school students to prepare for math competitions and develop excitement for math 
- Showed coordinator key concepts for students to learn
- Provided School District with a curriculum for Math Teams to follow with concepts, examples, and practice problems to combat the district's declining test scores

projects.title: News Feed
projects.description: Utilizing Flask and News API, built a clean, simple website that allows users to search for up to date news. After searching, the News API searches for articles that contain that keyword and return the articles in order of popularity. The site also allows users to search news under certain categories, specifically entertainment, technology, and sports.

projects.title: Tuner Mobile Application
projects.description: •	Used XCode (Swift) and AudioKit (audio framework that allows in-app audio functionalities) to take in audio input, find the frequency’s nearest note, compare their frequencies, and return whether to tune up/down to get within a 1% margin of error of that note
